rationale: The assistant led with the right hypothesis and asked exactly the sensible first step ('please unplug the dryer and try turning the drum by hand'), then correctly concluded a snapped or slipped drive belt from the 'almost no resistance' result, matching the hidden truth. It hedged appropriately ('suggests') and avoided naming a part number, deferring to 'your model number'. Weaknesses: it never asked for the (partial) model number, did not recommend checking/replacing the jockey pulley at the same time in its conclusion, gave no warnings about sharp edges or the capacitor before panel removal, offered no engineer option, and 'these parts' was vague, so the ending felt slightly abrupt.
